title: Intermittent payment timeouts during peak traffic
summary: During afternoon checkout peaks, payment requests began timing out in bursts while database connection utilisation climbed toward the pool limit.
symptoms: failures become more frequent during high traffic
rootCause: Database connection pool exhaustion during peak traffic.
resolution: Connection pool capacity was increased and pool configuration was corrected.

title: Sporadic checkout delays while authorisation waits on the provider
summary: Customers saw slow checkouts and occasional payment failures even though internal database metrics stayed within normal ranges.
resolution: Fallback provider routing was activated until the primary fictional-pay region recovered.

title: Immediate payment rejections after credential expiry
summary: Authorisation calls started failing instantly with provider authentication errors after an external API key passed its expiry date.
symptoms: authentication errors from external payment provider
resolution: Rotated the fictional-pay API credential and updated the Payment API secret reference.

title: Accepted payments stuck behind a growing processing backlog
summary: Checkout accepted customer payments, but settlement lagged as the background processing queue grew and worker throughput dropped.
rootCause: Background payment-processing queue saturation caused by too few workers.
resolution: Increased payment worker replicas and restored the queue concurrency settings.

title: Login latency from exhausted session-store connections
summary: Login and token refresh slowed sharply while session lookups waited on an exhausted Redis connection pool.
resolution: Raised the Redis pool maximum and recycled the Authentication Service pods after the config change.

title: Sudden token validation failures after signing key expiry
summary: Users were unable to complete authentication because issued tokens failed validation after the signing certificate expired.
rootCause: Expired signing certificate used for JWT validation.
resolution: Rotated the signing credentials and published the new signing key id.

title: Authentication error spike immediately after deployment
summary: A configuration regression in a canary release broke login for traffic pinned to the new pods while the previous revision continued to work.
symptoms: login works for some pods but not others
rootCause: Incorrect AUTH_SESSION_URL environment variable in the canary deployment.
resolution: Rolled back the canary and restored the correct session-store endpoint configuration.

title: Notification backlog after worker throughput collapse
summary: Email and in-app notifications lagged as the notifications queue depth climbed and workers drained messages too slowly.
rootCause: Queue saturation caused by insufficient worker throughput.
resolution: Increased worker concurrency and restored prefetch so the backlog drained.

title: Delivery failures under external mail provider throttling
summary: Outbound notification sends failed in waves as the fictional-mail API returned rate-limit responses and retries piled up.
symptoms: queue depth grows only during send bursts
resolution: Lowered the send rate and enabled provider-aware backoff until the throttling window ended.

title: Checkout timeouts while MongoDB pool sat at 96 of 100 connections
summary: Near-identical to peak-traffic saturation: payment requests intermittently timed out while database connections stayed near the configured maximum and latency climbed above 800 ms.
rootCause: Database connection pool saturation under checkout load.
resolution: Temporarily shed non-critical reporting queries and confirmed pool sizing matched traffic; permanent fix kept pool max at 100 with query budgeting.

title: Payment timeouts from a missing MongoDB index on settlement lookups
summary: Payment API latency and intermittent timeouts rose while connection counts looked elevated, but the real issue was collection scans on settlement lookups holding connections open.
rootCause: Missing compound index on settlement lookup queries caused long-running operations that exhausted the pool.
resolution: Created the missing MongoDB index and confirmed query plans no longer scanned the full collection.

title: Currency rounding rejected multi-currency checkout totals
summary: A small subset of international checkouts failed immediately with validation errors after a pricing change introduced half-cent rounding mismatches. Database and provider health were normal.
rootCause: Half-cent rounding mismatch between catalogue pricing and Payment API total validation.
resolution: Aligned rounding rules to banker's rounding for ISO currency minor units and redeployed Payment API.

title: Legacy pool exhaustion on payments-primary with max 5 connections
summary: Very old incident from the legacy payments-primary cluster where a tiny pool of 5 connections collapsed under modest traffic. Useful as outdated historical knowledge versus today's payments-prod-v2 / pool 100 environment.
rootCause: Legacy database connection pool of 5 was far too small for checkout concurrency.
resolution: Raised legacy pool max from 5 to 20 on payments-primary (later migrated away from this cluster).

title: Intermittent payment timeouts after DNS cache returned stale authorisation hosts
summary: Checkout latency and timeouts appeared similar to saturation incidents, but MongoDB pool metrics were healthy. Stale DNS answers sent authorisation calls to a decommissioned fictional-pay endpoint.
rootCause: Stale DNS cache pointed fictional-pay authorisation traffic at a retired hostname.
resolution: Flushed DNS caches and shortened TTL for the provider hostname; authorisation endpoints resolved correctly again.

title: MFA challenge failures during upstream SMS provider outage
summary: Password login succeeded but MFA challenges failed broadly while the fictional-sms provider returned 503s. Redis session metrics remained healthy.
rootCause: Upstream SMS provider regional outage blocked MFA delivery.
resolution: Enabled email-OTP fallback for MFA until fictional-sms recovered.

title: Broken Handlebars template stopped all password-reset emails
summary: A template deploy introduced a Handlebars syntax error. Workers stayed busy retrying a single broken template while other notification types queued behind it.
symptoms: queue depth increasing for one template
rootCause: Invalid Handlebars expression in the password-reset email template.
resolution: Rolled back the template revision and added a render dry-run check to the notification deploy pipeline.

title: Sparse evidence case: single-region tax calculator timeout
summary: Only EU checkout paths failed when a rarely used tax microservice timed out. Almost no overlapping symptoms with database pool saturation, so semantic search should score this weakly against pool incidents.
symptoms: checkout fails only for EU destinations
rootCause: Tax calculator sidecar in eu-west-1 exhausted CPU after a ruleset reload.
resolution: Restarted the tax calculator deployment and capped ruleset reload concurrency.
